error.rk001_rate_limit: This identifier has used up its daily sign-in quota (RK001 rate limit). Try again after 00:00
error.app_login_failed: The App channel did not sign in. Check the [custom_components.state_grid] lines in the Home Assistant log - they carry the server code and message
error.new_device_required: State Grid wants a one-time "new device" check, but the SMS could not be sent. Go back one step and submit your password again; if this keeps happening this phone number is being blocked and the integration cannot finish that step
error.invalid_verification_code: The code is wrong or has expired. Go back one step and resubmit your password so State Grid sends a new SMS
error.captcha_required: State Grid asked for a security check at this step (a slider or click captcha; the type code is RKxxx). That check has to be completed by Tencent's web widget, which the App interface cannot do here, so retrying won't make it go away. This is not a wrong password and not your network - the "network timeout" wording is the site's generic text for these codes
